query: How many customers are there?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers;

query: How many employees work at the bank?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees;

query: How many accounts of each type are there?
reference_sql: SELECT account_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM accounts GROUP BY account_type ORDER BY count DESC;

query: What is the total outstanding loan principal?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(principal) AS total_principal FROM loans WHERE status = 'active';

query: What is the average account balance?
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM accounts;

query: List savings accounts with a balance over $50,000
reference_sql: SELECT account_number, balance, currency FROM accounts WHERE account_type = 'savings' AND balance > 50000 LIMIT 50;

query: How many accounts are currently frozen?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts WHERE status = 'frozen';

query: Show me all active mortgage loans
reference_sql: SELECT id, principal, interest_rate, term_months FROM loans WHERE loan_type = 'mortgage' AND status = 'active' LIMIT 50;

query: How many loans have defaulted?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loans WHERE status = 'defaulted';

query: Show the top 5 customers by number of accounts they hold
reference_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(a.id) AS account_count FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY account_count DESC LIMIT 5;

query: How many employees does each branch have?
reference_sql: SELECT b.name, COUNT(e.id) AS employee_count FROM branches b JOIN employees e ON e.branch_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY employee_count DESC;

query: Which customers have the most loans?
reference_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(l.id) AS loan_count FROM customers c JOIN loans l ON l.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY loan_count DESC LIMIT 10;

query: What is the total transaction amount for each transaction type?
reference_sql: SELECT transaction_type, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions GROUP BY transaction_type ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

query: Who are the top 5 customers by total loyalty points?
reference_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(lp.points) AS total_points FROM loyalty.customers c JOIN loyalty.loyalty_points lp ON lp.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 5;

description: Customers with balance and loyalty points
query: Show me the account balance and total loyalty points for the top 5 customers by balance
reference_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(a.balance) AS total_balance, COALESCE(SUM(lp.points), 0) AS loyalty_points FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN loyalty.loyalty_points lp ON lp.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY total_balance DESC LIMIT 5;

query: How many rewards have been redeemed in total?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loyalty.rewards;

query: Which reward has been redeemed the most?
reference_sql: SELECT reward_name, COUNT(*) AS times_redeemed FROM loyalty.rewards GROUP BY reward_name ORDER BY times_redeemed DESC LIMIT 1;

description: Customers with both savings and rewards
query: How many customers have both a savings account and have redeemed at least one reward?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) FROM customers c JOIN accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.id AND a.account_type = 'savings' JOIN loyalty.rewards r ON r.customer_id = c.id;
